text: Create a feature flag in the Admin UI and connect it to your application by integrating an SDK
quote: Create your first feature flag using the Unleash Admin UI. Connect Unleash to your application by integrating an SDK into your codebase.

text: Gradual rollout releases a new feature to a small subset of users first
quote: A **gradual rollout** is a controlled release strategy where a new feature is first released to a small subset of users.

text: Release a feature at a specific date and time using a currentTime DATE_AFTER constraint
quote: Add a date-based constraint by selecting the `currentTime` context field (step 1 in the below image), choosing the `DATE_AFTER` operator

text: Self-host Unleash Open Source or Enterprise in your own environment using Docker / Docker Compose
quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.

text: Edge acts as a read replica serving thousands of connected SDKs without adding read load to the primary instance
quote: functioning as a read replica that can handle thousands of connected SDKs without increasing the read load on your primary Unleash instance

text: Enterprise Edge is a lightweight caching layer that improves scalability, performance and resilience
quote: Unleash Enterprise Edge is a lightweight caching layer designed to improve scalability, performance, and resilience.

text: PII used for targeting is processed within the Edge node and never sent to Unleash Cloud or the upstream instance
quote: user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance

text: Admin API gives full programmatic management of flags, projects, environments, users and integrations

text: MCP server lets LLM coding assistants create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices
quote: This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.

text: Variants expose different feature versions to users for A/B and multivariate testing
quote: Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.

text: Segments are reusable collections of strategy constraints that can be shared across any number of flags
quote: A segment is a reusable collection of strategy constraints... you can define a segment once and reuse it across any number of feature flags

text: Custom activation strategies and targeting
quote: Custom activation strategies and targeting

text: Combine multiple activation strategies, e.g. a 75% rollout plus guaranteed access for internal users
quote: to roll out a feature to 75% of users while granting access to internal users, you can add two activation strategies

text: Enable or disable features for certain users without redeploying the application
quote: They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.

text: Environments have separate flag configurations, so a flag can be on in dev/test but off in production
quote: each environment has different feature flag configurations. This allows you to enable a flag in development or test without enabling it in production.

text: Change requests require an additional approval step before changes are made in an environment
quote: Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.

text: Change requests can group changes and apply them at a specific point in time
quote: Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.

text: Role-based access control at root and project levels with predefined and custom roles
quote: Unleash implements role-based access control at root and project levels, with predefined and custom roles for precise permission management.

text: Enterprise users can create custom root roles and custom project roles
quote: Enterprise users can create their own custom root roles and custom project roles.

text: Backend API tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment
quote: Backend tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment.

text: Frontend tokens are non-secret and safe to expose in client-side code
quote: Frontend tokens are not considered secret and are safe to expose client-side.

text: Release templates provide predefined rollout sequences that can be applied to any feature flag
quote: Release templates: Predefined rollout sequences that you can apply to any feature flag.

text: Define a reusable rollout process that progresses automatically while monitoring application health

text: Safeguards automatically pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold
quote: Automate milestone progression or trigger safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold.

text: Advance a rollout milestone (e.g. 25% to 50%) only if error rates stay below a threshold
quote: Progress from 25% to 50% only if error rates stay below a threshold.

text: Automatically pause a rollout when request latency increases
quote: Pause automatically when request latency increases during a rollout.

text: Rollout metrics are queried at read time from your existing Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics, keeping data in your system
quote: External metrics are queried at read time from your existing Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics instance. The data stays in your system.

text: 15 official client/server SDKs plus over 15 community SDKs
quote: It supports 15 official client and server SDKs and over 15 community SDKs.

text: Export and import feature flags for migration
quote: Export/import feature flags for easy migration

text: Dedicated dashboard to track stale feature flags
quote: Track stale feature flags with a dedicated dashboard

text: Single sign-on via SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect (Azure AD, Okta)

text: Hosted instance with unlimited projects and environments, plus SCIM user provisioning
quote: This gives you access to a hosted instance with unlimited projects and environments and features such as role-based access control, change requests, single sign-on, and SCIM
